svg.title: Known-best packing of 126 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=126 construction, never the source witness: Evan Daniel's regularizer's view of it, its contacts re-solved exactly at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 268af52 rational centre/half-angle certificate of Ryan Xu's n126 packing as reconstructed from a picture, retained from the source. Finite construction feasibility only; no exact form, local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=126 regularized: side ~ 11.74264069 (certified upper bound)
